title: Chapter 455
text:
You have used [Mission Completion Card].

[Trial of the Strong] in progress … Current Progress: 1/1

Level 100 Promotion Mission completed! END bonus increased! 1 END = 50 HP = 60 Constitution

"Done."

After the dust settled, Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief. Level 60 was the first Race Evolution, and level 100 was the second Race Evolution.

"I once used the Void Dragon Marrow to obtain the [Void Genes] talent. This can increase the options for Race Evolution and add a new evolution path."

The Race Evolution options were randomly selected according to the Evolution Tree. A few options with higher compatibility would be selected, and there would also be an option with lower compatibility that would provide the player with a completely different path.

You have taken another step forward on the path of evolution. You have received a Life Evolution Upgrade. Detected Race: [Type-1 Space Human] … Randomly selecting six compatible evolution paths … Selection complete.

Please select one of the six options below to be your Race Evolution. Warning! The evolution process is irreversible. Please choose carefully! [Appendix: Evolution Path Characteristics]

[Type-2 Space Human] -94% Compatibility, [Type-3 Space Human] -92% Compatibility, [North Wind God] -75% Compatibility, [Void Prowler (Human Form)] -81% Compatibility, [Half-Dragon Hybrid] -64% Compatibility, [Intermediate Mechanical Life] -22% Compatibility.

Selection complete. Evolving Race … Evolution complete.

Race changed to [Void Prowler (Human Form)]. Molecular structure improved, organ structure strengthened, metabolism changed, adaptability increased … Your potential has increased!

You have received bonus stats: + 28 STR, + 45 DEX, + 15 END, + 24 INT, + 36 MYS, + 22 CHA, + 570 Energy. Energy Level bonus stats have changed!

Your Race Characteristic [Adaptability Group] has changed.

You have received Racial Trait [Void Travel].

You have received the Racial Trait [Void Mirror Image].

You have received Racial Trait [Void Shadow]

The excruciating pain of being skinned and torn apart came like a tsunami, but Han Xiao was already mentally prepared. Every time a race evolved, one's genes and cells would undergo a huge change. The players could ignore the pain, but he could not. Gritting his teeth, dense green veins appeared on his face, wriggling crazily like green snakes. His eyes were blood-red, and the capillaries in his eyeballs were all exploding. The rhombus-shaped skin between his brows that was modified by the Void Gene let out a blurry gray light. Gray lines extended out from his face and rapidly covered his entire body, changing the cells in his body.

Zi, zi, zi — —

The boundless energy in his body was out of control. The wild electric light was like dozens of lightning whips, crazily lashing out. The air was filled with a burnt smell, and the ground was scorched black.

"Pu …" Han Xiao suddenly opened his mouth and spat out a mouthful of blood. The bright red blood seemed to be boiling and bubbling, turning into a bluish-purple color at a speed visible to the naked eye.

This time, the pain lasted longer than any of the previous times. The Void Prowler could be considered a completely different life form, and it was an earth-shattering change. This was the special evolution path that the Void Gene had given him. Regardless of future potential or race characteristics, he was one of the best out of the six options.

Type 2 and Type 3 Universe Human Race were the conventional evolution paths. They had different inclinations and were generally more moderate. The advantage was that they were very versatile, which meant that they could take many different paths. Han Xiao had chosen this path at Level 60 because he wanted to find a strong evolution path. Now, he had found it. The Void Race was like the Demon Race and the Energy Life Race. This was an entire species evolution path. It was rare, powerful, and had great potential.

As for the other options, the [Northern Wind God Race] was a special race. Their bodies were innately strong, their vitality was tenacious, and their reproduction ability was explosive. They called themselves the God Race. The [Half-Dragon Half-Blood] was also a representation of a strong body. These two were suitable for Pugilists. As for the [Intermediate Mechanical Life], it was a complete change of species, turning into a mechanical life form. It no longer had energy, and its compatibility was too low, so he definitely would not choose it.

After a long time, the pain slowly subsided. Han Xiao felt as if he had been fished out of a sea of blood. During the last period of time, what seeped out of his pores was no longer sweat but human blood. At this time, all the blood in his body had been completely replaced, and his senses were completely different. Other than the five senses of a human, he had a few new senses. He could feel the flow of free energy and see the Void Vision. It was as if he had opened the door to a new world.

Taking out a mirror, Han Xiao looked at his current appearance. His whole body had grown another ten centimeters. Luckily, his five limbs were still that of a human, and there was no additional tail or arms. However, inside his body, the structure of his bones, muscles, and organs had completely changed. The degree of complexity was several times higher than that of a human.

His appearance was not much different from before, and he was still as handsome as before. The diamond-shaped skin between his eyebrows had turned into an indigo crystal. This was a new organ that could be controlled and used to feel the Void Vision. His skin was even fairer than before, and his whole body exuded a mysterious aura.

Not bad, he still has the appearance of a human. This is the human form of a Void Prowler. Originally, what kind of race was it? After becoming a Void Prowler, it could still maintain its original appearance. Only when it was contaminated with the Void Gene, most species would be able to mutate into a Void Prowler.

Han Xiao was very knowledgeable. The three race characteristics were all talents of the Void Prowler, and among them, [Void Travel] was the core ability.

Let's see what it feels like.

The world in front of him suddenly changed, and everything turned into a foggy state. It was as if he was looking at the real world through a layer of medium. This was the Void Vision, and he had entered a mirror dimension that reflected reality. The flow of time was different. When Han Xiao moved, the real world was basically still. However, he could not actually affect reality, and he could only pass through material objects. The two dimensions were like a mirror, and they could not interfere with each other. It was equivalent to moving freely in stealth mode. [Void Travel] did not have a time limit, but it continuously consumed a large amount of stamina while using the skill. The cooldown was five minutes.

Han Xiao walked from one corner of the room to the other and counted silently for a few seconds before deactivating the skill. When he returned to reality again, he looked at his watch. This movement had not consumed any time at all.

So, the performance of this ability in reality is similar to Blink, Teleport, or Short Range Warp. Han Xiao nodded to himself. According to his senses, this talent was like a weakened version of the Time Deceleration ability. The only difference was that it could not affect things in reality.

At this time, he looked at himself in the mirror and noticed the changes in his body. When he used the race characteristic of the Void Prowler, he would leave his usual human form and enter the Void Form. This was because only then could he come into contact with the Void Dimension. The skin of his whole body turned into a crystalline grey, and there was a glimmer of starlight flowing through his skin. The originally white skin would converge into lines that looked like battle runes, spreading along the bone structure all over his body. The end of the white lines would gather at the crystal between his eyebrows.

Han Xiao waited for a while, and his body automatically returned to its original state. The white lines spread out again, covering his skin as he returned to his human form. The grey skin in the Void Form was like a river flowing into the sea, and it was sucked back into the crystal.

What a magical lifeform. I don't want to be human anymore!

Han Xiao kept switching between the two forms, familiarizing himself with them for a while.

As for the other two race characteristics, one was to form a mirror image that did not have any combat ability and could only confuse the enemy. The other was to summon a Void Shadow that would exist for thirty minutes. It would not be injured, had no offensive ability, and had extremely fast movement speed. It could be used to scout the way or interfere with the enemy's vision. These two race characteristics also consumed a lot of stamina.

Most races only had one or two talents, and three talents were already a lot. The talents of the Void Prowler mainly focused on interference, confusion, and evasion. Among them, [Void Travel] was the most important and could be considered a super powerful evasion ability. It had an extremely strong life-saving effect, and the cooldown was only five minutes.

On the interface, the Class Advancement requirements for his main class had already been completed, and it notified him that he had obtained the next class.

You have received a new class [War Mechanic Lv.1]. + 120 Energy, + 3 DEX, + 3 END, + 5 INT. You have received 6 Free Attribute Points and 1 Potential Point.

You have learned the ability [Applied Machinery Affinity].

You have learned the ability [Waste Modification].

You have learned the ability [Mechanical Overload].

You have learned the ability [Mechanical Force Combat Technique (Locked)].

You have learned the talent [Battlefield Rationality].

War Mechanic was the sixth stage of the Mechanic class, and it had already reached the middle stage of stability. This was the time when the Mechanic class began to show its power. The level limit of this class was LV 20. As the name suggested, at this stage, the Mechanic class finally began to lean toward actual combat. Other than the new Machinery Affinity, the other skills were all combat skills.

He invested his experience into his main class and leveled it up again and again.

[War Mechanic] leveled up to LV 16. + 120 Energy, + 3 DEX, + 3 END, + 5 INT. You have received 6 Free Attribute Points and 1 Potential Point.

After reaching LV 100, the EXP required to level up increased with each level. Han Xiao currently had about 1,600,000,000 EXP, and he spent 1,300,000,000 EXP to level up more than ten times. He was only four levels away from the LV 20 upper limit of [War Mechanic], and he did not have enough EXP left.

The experience that he had gained from the players in Version 1.0 was finally going to be used up!

"I still have close to 300,000,000 experience left. I can level up again, but it's not as cost-effective as leveling up my skills. Also, I need to synthesize the two High-End Knowledges into new blueprints. It's more useful to keep them … Haha, I'm finally going to use up this huge pile of experience."

Han Xiao smiled in satisfaction. He had not felt the lack of experience for a long time. Not only did he not feel uncomfortable, but he also felt very happy and missed it. He had calculated long ago that he would definitely use up all this experience after his Promotion at LV 100.

This was a great thing. The experience that was stored on the interface was just a number. It was no different from earning money and not spending it. Only by turning it into combat power would it be useful. When he was playing in the game in his previous life, the most satisfying moment was when he used up all his experience.

How could earning money be better than spending it! Spending it! Squandering it! Creating it!

Now that he had finally digested all the experience that he had accumulated in Version 1.0, he felt a strong sense of fulfillment.

During the version update, the players were not around, so there was no way to quickly harvest experience. When the next version started, it would be time for him to harvest experience crazily again.

"After spending all this experience, I'm now at LV 116. Very good. When the players appear again, it will be time for my strength to increase explosively."
